notes.title: Patch
notes.notes:
1.The event about interaction with Yemen pops up on Yemen, not the USSR.

2. The maximum threshold for Westalgia has been returned.

3. If you introduce a puppet regime in Krajina for democratic Croatia or in Montenegro for Milosevic, you can dispose of buildings on their territory.

4. Fixed typos and bugs.

notes.title: Update 2.5
notes.notes:

3. Two new answer choices and 1 new ending for the GDR.
4. New achievement.
5. Bug fixes.

Enjoy the game!

notes.title: Patch 2.3.7
notes.notes:

2. DPRK now has left-wing support in Japan at the start.
3. Fixed typos and bugs.

notes.title: Patch 2.3.6
notes.notes:
1. Reduced the NATO threat condition (from 40 to 50) for supporting left-wing organisations in Japan.

2. Romania has authoritarian government when playing for any country.

3. Reformist Japan can be created by the SPJ. 

4. Fixed typos and bugs.

notes.title: Update 2.3.5
notes.notes:
The update includes:

1. Changed interactions with Taiwan.
2. Expanded the number of actions in international events in the game for Afghanistan after studying the technology ‘Development of foreign agents’.
3. Added two new events for the Japanese and Indian elections in 1990 and 1991 respectively. Changed past events related to these countries.
4. B. Trifunovic replaced S. Milosevic in the ministers of Yugoslavia.
5. Fixed typos and bugs.

Enjoy the game!

notes.title: Update 2.3
notes.notes:
The update includes:

1. Changed the flag of Afghanistan to a more historical to the game period, the country itself added to the initial map of the choice of countries.
2. Added an additional option for contact with reformist Libya.
3. Added an option to support anti-Turkish organisations to gain ostalgia.
4. Lowered diplomatic reputation requirements for trade with Taiwan (now requires less than 70, instead of 50).
5. It is now impossible to trade with Taiwan and be in the same economic union with the PRC.
6. Fixed bugs and typos.

Enjoy the game!

And don't forget that we have other games created by our team: Crisis in the Kremlin. China: Mao's Legacy, The Collapse: A Political Simulator!

notes.title: Update 2.2.5
notes.notes:
The update includes:

1. Added option to support socialist forces in Sri Lanka after 1989 or make a deal with the old government.
2. Added option to invite foreign investors from NATO countries.
3. Foreign investors can invest under state capitalism.
4. The possibility to enter into oil contracts with Iran or Iraq has been added.
5. Egypt, with the help of a player, will be able to make economic reforms and change its state structure
6. If we do not help Syria and Lebanon, in 1991 their ideology will change to "market dictatorship".
7. Fixed bugs related to Kuwait.

Enjoy the game!

notes.title: Update 2.2.4
notes.notes:
Includes:

1. Fixed interaction with Kuwait under American occupation. 
2. When Alksnis coup occurs, left-wing nationalist regimes are established in liberal Warsaw Pact countries.
3. Eased the conditions for achieving ‘Only extremes lead to success’.
4. Fixed typos and bugs.

Have a nice play!

notes.title: Update 2.2.2
notes.notes:
Patchnote:

1. Changed the name of Kuwait under Iraqi occupation.
2. Changed the icon of Market Authoritarianism.
3. Rebalanced Italy buttons, added a new button that allows you to support the ‘Movement for Peace in Italy’.
4. Added separate combinations of policies for the sub-ideologies of the player's country. 
5. Fixed typos and bugs.
6. Unity version changed from 2019.2.19 to 2019.2.21.

Happy New Year!

notes.title: Update 2.2
notes.notes:
1. Added new achievement for Yugoslavia. 
2. Changed Albania buttons, supporting democrats now reduces Socialist camp stability, added ability to invite Tirana to EU.
3. Event on imposing sanctions against Iraq now also reduces the stability of the socialist camp, as well as the button action of the same name on the diplomatic map.
4. Added one new ending each for Slovenia and Macedonia.
5. Changed the picture of Market Authoritarianism.
6. Fixed English localisation errors, typos and bugs.

Translated with DeepL.com (free version)

notes.title: Update 2.1.6
notes.notes:
1. Added new system of life level influence on player's actions.
2. Depending on the player's choice in the ‘Polish Question’ event, the subideology of Poland will change.
3. Supporting Generals for Peace can now be done by any country after learning SORM and helping the socialist camp.
4. DPRK can now join CMEA on the ‘Betrayal of an Old Friend’ event.
5. In the ‘Decommunisation’ event, Westalgia will decrease, not increase, when it is carried out.
6. Added the ability to support anti-government organisations in Israel.
7. Made minor changes to the subideology system for the player.
8. Fixed typos and bugs.

Have a nice play!

notes.title: Update 2.1.5
notes.notes:

2. The sub-ideology of Reformist Ireland has been replaced with ‘Red Toryism’.
3. Finland's sub-ideology is changed to liberal conservatism after the 1991 election.
4. Pakistan can no longer be traded with when sanctions are imposed on it.
5. The opportunity to influence the course of the war in Afghanistan is expanded. 
6. Added sub-ideologies for the player's country.

Translated with DeepL.com (free version)

notes.title: Ostalgie: The Disorder in Yugoslavia - Release!
notes.notes:
Dear friends! 

We successfully completed the move from Ukraine and legally took shape in another country, and now you can again buy any of our games and we will be able to receive money from them. 

In this regard, we hasten to announce that DLC Ostalgie: Disorder in Yugoslavia has been released and is available for purchase!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1886380/Ostalgie_Disorder_in_Yugoslavia/

P.S. Due to the fact that we live off the development, support and sale of our creations - we ask you to buy our new DLC, regardless of what is happening in the world now. Sincery, your loving Kremlingames team ♡♡♡

notes.title: DLC release freeze
notes.notes:
Unfortunately, we are forced to announce the freeze on the release of the Yugoslavia add-on to Ostalgie. Due to the ongoing war in Ukraine, we are experiencing problems in the possible receipt of your funds that you will spend on purchasing this DLC, in other words, we do not know for sure whether we will be able to get this money, whether it will be lost in the confusion of the war. The DLC is completely ready, but the date of its release is postponed approximately, most likely, to the date of the end of the war and the stabilization of the banking sector of Ukraine. If the situation with the banking system does not clear up by the beginning of March, then we will start looking for solutions to withdraw the campaign from Ukraine, so the add-on will most likely be released in March-April for sure. Keep calm. Thank you for looking forward to our projects, DLС, updates, we are glad to see that you are not indifferent to our work!

For dear brothers and sisters, citizens of Ukraine and Russia, we appeal to you: the most important thing now is not to succumb to provocations. Every sane Ukrainian, every sane Russian, each of us should not succumb to provocations, should not be angry with each other, ordinary Ukrainians should not be angry with Russians, and ordinary Russians with Ukrainians - no matter what. Do not participate in inciting hatred between Ukrainians and Russians. Fakes are pouring from all sides. Stay vigilant - stay at home - take care of yourself.
